backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing trending topics, video projects, user accounts/profiles with access control, blob storage mixins, and CRUD operations for creating topics (admin-only), generating scripts, managing video projects, and user profile management.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting the requirement to update TrendingTopicCard to serialize and pass complete trending topic data (ID, title, hashtags, keywords, platform, metrics) when navigating to VideoConfigurationPage.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including pages, components, and hooks, noting that TrendingPage passes topic data via URL search parameters and VideoConfigurationPage reads from those parameters instead of backend fetch.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, defining colors for background, foreground, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx, titled 'AI Trending Video Maker'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app with TanStack Router setup, route definitions for all pages (landing, trending, templates, editor, configure, export, account), AuthGuard for protected routes, and LayoutWrapper with ProfileSetupDialog for first-time users.
frontend/src/components/CoinPurchaseDial: Modal dialog for purchasing coin packages (100, 500, 1000) with selectable cards, current balance display, popular badge, and purchase mutation using useAddCoins hook.
frontend/src/components/ExportProgress.t: Progress bar component displaying export percentage and dynamic status messages based on completion stage (preparing, rendering, adding audio, finalizing).
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout component with header navigation (Trending, Templates, Account), authentication-aware routing, and footer with Caffeine.ai attribution. Displays user profile name and login button when authenticated.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that toggles between login/logout states, handles Internet Identity authentication flow, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: Modal dialog for new user onboarding that collects name and username, creates user profile with free tier subscription, and initializes user account.
frontend/src/components/SubscriptionCard: Premium subscription upgrade card displaying feature comparison (watermark-free exports, unlimited renders, HD quality, etc.) with upgrade button.
frontend/src/components/TimelineTrack.ts: Visual timeline track component that displays items proportionally by duration with color-coded segments, icons, and labels for video editing interface.
frontend/src/components/TrendingTopicCar: Card component displaying trending topic details including platform badge, hashtags, keywords, engagement metrics (views, likes, shares, comments), and create video button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook managing backend actor creation with Internet Identity authentication, initializes access control with admin token, and invalidates dependent queries on actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status states using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty placeholder file indicating queries are organized in feature-specific hook files rather than centralized.
frontend/src/hooks/useScriptGeneration.t: Mutation hook for generating video scripts from topics with configurable language, duration, and style parameters via backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useTrendingTopics.ts: Query hooks for fetching trending topics: individual topic by ID, filtered by platform, and sorted by engagement metrics.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserAccount.ts: React Query hooks for user account operations including fetching account details, creating accounts, upgrading to premium, and adding coins.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the caller's user profile with loading states and cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoProject.ts: React Query hooks for video project operations including fetching individual projects, listing caller's projects, and updating project status.
frontend/src/hooks/useVideoProjectMutati: React Query mutation hook for creating new video projects with title, topic, script, stock videos, music, voiceover, and format parameters.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind imports, CSS custom properties for light/dark themes, and font configuration including Hindi (Devanagari) support.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/ExportPage.tsx: Page for exporting video projects with progress tracking, simulated rendering, and download functionality with premium/free tier differentiation.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Marketing landing page showcasing AI video creation features with hero banner, feature grid highlighting trending topics, AI scripts, and auto video creation.
frontend/src/pages/TemplateLibraryPage.t: Page displaying pre-configured video templates across categories (News, Review, Motivation, etc.) with preview cards and navigation to trending topics.
frontend/src/pages/TimelineEditorPage.ts: Displays a video project's timeline editor with script details, timeline tracks for video clips, background music, voiceover, and text overlays, plus an export button. Fetches project data by ID and shows loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/TrendingPage.tsx: Shows trending topics across platforms (YouTube, Instagram, TikTok) with hardcoded mock data including metrics, hashtags, and keywords. Uses tabs to filter by platform and displays topics in cards.
frontend/src/pages/UserAccountPage.tsx: Displays user account dashboard showing subscription tier (Free/Premium), coin balance with purchase option, and list of created video projects. Includes upgrade to premium functionality and project management.
frontend/src/pages/VideoConfigurationPag: Configuration page for creating videos from trending topics, allowing users to select language, style, voiceover, format, and duration, then generate and edit scripts before creating a video project. Receives topic data via URL parameters.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining custom color schemes using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings including container queries, typography, animations, and custom font families for a dark-mode-enabled UI with sidebar and chart components.
project_state.json: Project state file documenting an AI-powered mobile video creation app with features for generating short-form videos from trending topics, including existing features like landing page, trending page, template library, timeline editor, video configuration, and export functionality, with a known issue regarding the AI script generator not opening from trending topics.
